answer: Living juniper stops sybil farms in the canyon. A newcomer plants one juniper sapling in a canyon plot, registers its GPS and photo in the public ledger, and two auditors confirm the tree is alive after ninety days; a dead or missing tree means rejection and a ban. One honest agent plants one timber sapling once; a thousand fakes need a thousand living trees tended for ninety days, and no farm can water them all.
